raw_response:
I am too old to spend money on chemical fertilizer for beans when maize needs it more, and beans have always grown well enough with what the soil gives. I will spread the little compost and manure we collect from the homestead, and I will plant the bean seed I saved from last year because I trust it. My children and grandchildren will help me weed and harvest when they are free, but we have no money to hire ganyu workers from the village. We wait for the rains God sends from November to April, so I will not irrigate this small plot.
